result.topic_en: The page describes factoring an integer derived from a number A (A·10^13), showing that a factor is composite with a method from the Disquisitiones Arithmeticae, rewriting A as an integer ratio times an exponential, and adding high-precision natural logarithms of 8819, 1865, 325, 81 and π.

methods.what: Factorisation of the integer part of A·10^13 into small factors and one large cofactor
